# The three-day course of October 2026 is rebuilt as the Extended course.
aliases:
  - ../eu-frames-three-days/index.html
  - ../eu-frames-three-days/slides.html
---

The Extended course builds two more days around the [one-day workshop](../eu-frames-one-day/index.qmd) on the EU-frames case. The first day teaches open research and the tools of the course, and it is the same for every case of AR4DS. The second day is the workshop itself, unchanged. The third day teaches the methods of this case as taught sessions, from the panel of 27 countries to the respondents within them, and it ends with a report of your own, in which the analysis that you declared on the second day is written up in Quarto and kept under Git.

The case is a study of Eurobarometer surveys, which asked whether the economic crisis changed how citizens of the member states frame the European Union, and a claim of the original author (OA) that five analysts reanalysed in the Multi100 project. On the second day you work as analyst no. 6, and the first and third days give that work its context and its methods.

## The days

- **[Before the course](before.qmd).** You install R and the workspace, work through the first module on R, read the case study, and download the Eurobarometer files that the work on respondents needs.
- **[Day 1 – Open research and the tools](day-1.qmd).** Credibility and the three Rs, SCORE and Multi100, repositories and data sources, and then R, Positron and Quarto, taught live.
- **[Day 2 – The workshop](day-2.qmd).** The one-day workshop in its four parts: the claim and credibility, the estimand and the causal graph, the reproduction, and robustness.
- **[Day 3 – The methods and your report](day-3.qmd).** Panel data, multilevel models with the respondents of the surveys, and Bayesian estimation, taught on the data of the case, and then your declared analysis written up as a short report under version control.
- **[After the course](after.qmd).** The page says where to go next in the companion curriculum.

[Start with Before the course](before.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

A two-day version of the course drops the third day and leaves the methods of the case to self-study, before and after. The same case is also taught as the [one-day workshop](../eu-frames-one-day/index.qmd) on its own, and as a [self-study route](../self-study/index.qmd).
